verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a hosted email service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions region selection or data residency. The only related evidence is configurable data retention duration (45-day default, up to 365 days), which is a different control from where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
